turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Don't thank me, answer me. Who decided on the zero, and when?
Can I ask you something? How should teachers talk to parents like you? What works?
You're asking me how to do your job? You talk to me with a document that has a date on it, not a question. Who decided on the zero?
What could I have said differently just now?
I'm on the other side of this table, Hale. I'm writing down that you've asked me twice how to handle this and haven't answered once. Withdraw the zero, or tell me who decided it.
